name: prepare_session_distill
description: Prepare one remember-this-session decision packet. An explicit session_id selects that session directly, including parked work. Semantic mode checks the complete source so the common path can finalize without another prepare call.

project_name.description: Optional context label for selected-session processing; it is not a globally unique directory identity.

client.description: Transcript source to sync before distill (default: auto)

limit.description: Optional session count to sync before distill; omitted means all matching sessions

full_rescan.description: Ignore sync cursor and rescan matching sessions

scope.description: Use all for device-wide selected-session processing without directory setup; project preserves explicit legacy source filters.

project_root.description: Optional source context for repository evidence; not required for selected device sessions or verified user statements.

observation_limit.description: Optional observation count; omitted includes all matching observations

run_ingest.description: Run low-level transcript sync before building the packet (default: true)

batch_sessions.description: Freeze selected native references from inspection for continuous manual processing. Device sources are fully read and bound one at a time; no directory setup, background CLI or source deletion.

batch_id.description: Resume the next unresolved item in an existing manual batch

retry_failures.description: Explicitly retry failed sources in an active batch, or recheck unfinished points in a directly selected completed session; never resets a stopped batch

distill_job_id.description: Optional active job id to claim exactly. Used by automatic maintenance so the selected job is processed deterministically.

session_id.description: Optional user-facing session id to select directly. The latest matching project job is activated when parked.

defer_job_id.description: Failed job to release as retryable and skip for this call.

defer_reason.description: Bounded failure reason stored with defer_job_id.

chunk_limit.description: Optional chunk count for caller-controlled batching; omitted claims all remaining chunks

evidence_mode.description: Evidence delivery mode. raw preserves the existing per-chunk Agent loop; semantic lets runtime hash-verify/checkpoint every raw chunk and returns the smaller parser-derived session rendering.

detail_level.description: compact returns complete readable exchanges and necessary references without duplicated diagnostics; full includes diagnostic details.

budget_tokens.description: Advisory diagnostic-response budget, never a source-reading limit. Complete conversation is retained in the normal response.

drilldown_exchange_indexes.description: Read complete semantic windows for selected one-based exchange indexes before querying candidate-grade raw proof.

drilldown_chunk_indexes.description: Read-only raw chunk indexes to return after a job reaches reviewing; use for candidate-grade evidence drilldown.

drilldown_query.description: Read-only search over raw chunks after the job reaches reviewing. Returns every matching chunk when semantic evidence needs proof.
